# Two hops means escalate

`customer_support.heu.ticket_triage.two_hops_means_escalate` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> A ticket that has been triaged twice should be escalated, not triaged a third time.


## The heuristic

**A ticket that has been triaged twice should be escalated, not triaged a third time.**


_Why:_ Two failed routings means the taxonomy does not contain this ticket. A third pass under the same rules reaches the same wrong answer, more slowly, with more of the clock gone.
